scope: Contact audit of every claimed joint. Measures interference and minimum distance, because zero overlap alone cannot tell a seated joint from a floating part.

joints.note: coincident faces only: no fit, key, screw or bond is defined

findings.issue: Ring is not clamped by any front screw
findings.measured: eight screws engage 0.0000 mm3 of ring material; ring flange top z 8.750, screw tips z 9.950, gap 1.200 mm
findings.consequence: The ring and the stator it carries have no load path to the housing; the eight screws hold nothing.

findings.issue: Ring mounting flange no longer overlaps the ring's toothed band
findings.measured: toothed band top z 10.750, flange top z 8.750, shortfall 2.000 mm
findings.consequence: The flange is intended to be the ring's mounting rim; it now sits below the teeth it is meant to carry.

findings.issue: Carrier is retained on the hub by nothing
findings.measured: carrier web vs hub interference 0.000000 mm3, min distance 0.0000 mm
findings.consequence: Coincident radii at r 22.25 mm with no fit class, key, screw or bond. The rotor torque path from carrier to hub is undefined.

findings.issue: Carrier web intersects the rear housing
findings.measured: 194.333 mm3 against NAUO4 (inward wall only r 29 mm over z -5.25..-4.75); 0.000 mm3 against the modified main housing
findings.consequence: The rear housing cannot be seated while the carrier spans z -5..+5.
